title.narrative: Capacity Building for the Implementation of a MTEF

description.narrative: Hands on capacity building along side the development of the MTEF. This proposal requests funding for specialist consultants that will assist Mauritius key central and sectoral ministries to develop institutional mechanisms for medium term planning and budgeting in the implementation of the NEA. At the central levelcomma critical will be bringing together the MOF and the MED and developing synergies among their capable but independent staff to work as a team in (i) developing the implementation agenda for the MTEF and (ii) sketching out a strategy for monitoring and evaluation. For 6 pilot sectoral ministriescomma preliminary work on sectoral analysis has already been completed; consulting services are needed to develop consistent frameworks for analysis of sector objectivescomma performancecomma role of governmentcomma role of the private sector and financing issuescomma than can be easily used in intersectoral resource allocation discussions. Sectoral ministries will also need assistance in fine-tuning M&E systems. Since assistance on public/private partnerships (PPP) is deemed of particular specializationcomma and comma three experts on PPP for educationcomma vocational trainingcomma and health will be hired to assist the ministries in developing proposals. For the CSOcomma the proposed activities include training on statistical application softwarecomma data analysis trainingcomma monitoring and evaluation trainingcomma and post-analysis review and dissemination. Structure and timing of proposed assistance. GOM and the Bank would like to organize the proposed assistance into 4 partscomma which would be proceeding almost in parallelcomma since the there would be separate national counterparts for each group. Part A. MTEF and M &E strategy for MOF and MOED. [2 intl consultants; 4 natl consultants] Tasks: ()review existing budget preparation system and existing level of M&E usage at budget preparation and monitoring levels ()develop with GOM a phased strategy for implementing an MTEF; including formalizing the training assistance through a practical manual (e.g. handbook) for central and 6 pilot ministriescomma with a detailed work program and objectives to be met during implementation (for both central and pilot ministries) comma ()develop with GOM a phased strategy for implementing an M &E; including formalizing the training assistance through a practical implementation (for both central and pilot ministries); development of statistical training program as necessarycomma with links to CSO (Part D below). comma ()training Mauritian officials and technicians on promotion of the MTEF (culturecomma strengths and weaknessescomma and experience sharing ) and on implementation technical skills (planning evaluationcomma logframecomma external or internal evaluationcomma ex ante or ex postcomma link to decision-making processcomma etc….)comma ()the team will be providing a study paper aiming at (a) taking stock of existing monitoring and evaluation capabilities and activities within the Governmentcomma (b) establishing partnerships to undertake such M &E actionscomma (c) identifying good practices examples to be presented at workshopscomma and (d) determining decentralization M &E capacity to local levels. The three-mission approachcomma over the proposed two year period for implementation of the IDF grant is expected to provide structure for on-the-job training to the national staff of the central ministries in the development of the MTEF. The role of the national consultants is expected to be (i) familiarize themselves with MTEF issues under Part A and (ii) assist sectoral ministries in the development of their thinking under Part B. National consultants are also expected to provide facilitation services and act as resource people the central and sectoral ministries during the times that the international consultants are not in Mauritius.
